newsitem.title: USA: Polaroid says int'l sales hurt by Russia.
newsitem.headline: Polaroid says int'l sales hurt by Russia.

text.p: CAMBRIDGE, Mass., July 17 ( Reuter) - Polaroid Corp said Thursday that international sales in the second quarter of 1997 were hurt by sales in Russia, which were "substantially" lower than in the second quarter of 1996.
International sales, which totaled $270.9 million in the second quarter compared to $304.3 million a year ago, were also negatively affected by the strength of the U.S. dollar, the company said.

Worldwide sales for the second quarter of 1997 were $564.9 million, compared to sales of $581.6 million in the prior year period. U.S. sales were $294.0 million in 1997's second quarter, up six percent from $277.3 million a year ago.
